description: A retained candidate can still allocate different K and V bitrates, contrary to the commit's stated goal.
trigger: Attention-only allocation with Q/K/V/O weight counts 256/128/128/256, target 3 and incoming surplus 640.
expected_behavior: K and V receive equal bitrates if the stated goal is universal.
actual_behavior: The patched allocator selects 3/4/5/4 and returns surplus 1.

verification.description: Executed the extracted parent function with the two task substitutions and synthetic objects providing keys and weight counts.
verification.limits: Not a complete conversion. Both inspected block callers expose this allocator; occurrence of these budgets in real models was not measured.
